gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees himself.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who…' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.lead: You didn't tell me about the meeting, and you should have.
gaps.sentence: You really ___ me about the meeting.
gaps.explanation: ought to have + participle = should have done (but didn't).

gaps.lead: The tickets are certain to be expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: be bound to do = be certain to do.

gaps.lead: The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).

gaps.lead: Selling the boat was a big mistake.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle expresses regret about a past action.

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.
